message.frieren_arcana.created: Barrier formed • radius %s • until released or shattered
spell.frieren_arcana.examination_barrier: A sealed, faintly green dome like Serie's barrier over the Grobe Basin. Blocks both directions, including its caster, and keeps out rain. Recast or use the Release Sigil to dismiss.
spell.frieren_arcana.defensive_barrier.g: Ordinary defensive magic: a sphere of hexagonal cells that disperses incoming spells. Weak to physical mass. Stronger spells crack or shatter it from the point of impact. Recast to dismiss.
spell.frieren_arcana.barrier_breaker.gui: Frieren's unravelling of Serie's barrier (ep. 21). In her cupped hands a green and black non-Euclidean shape turns through itself and compresses, then a single cone of light rises straight up into the dome; the barrier bands, cracks and shatters into falling shards. Examination barriers only; you must stand inside or beneath one. Needs full mana. K or Escape skips the camera.
spell.frieren_arcana.mana_sight.guide: Toggle visible mana auras and read a targeted player’s apparent Iron’s Spellbooks mana. Concealment can fool this sight.
spell.frieren_arcana.zoltraak.guide: Ordinary Offensive Magic: a cylindrical beam of white killing magic fired from a small circle at your hand. Bends slightly onto a creature under your crosshair. Blocked by terrain and barriers. Damage: 1× spell power to the first target hit.
spell.frieren_arcana.flight.guide: Hold a staff in either hand. Double-tap jump for ordinary flight. A staff appears beneath you. Mana drains only while flying.
spell.frieren_arcana.mana_concealment.gu: Toggle suppression of your visible mana aura. Your actual mana remains usable. Persists through logout.
message.frieren_arcana.error.limit: The dimension has reached its active barrier limit.
message.frieren_arcana.error.height: The sphere must fit between the world’s build limits.
message.frieren_arcana.error.border: The sphere must fit inside the world border.
message.frieren_arcana.error.overlap: Barrier surfaces cannot intersect. Place the sphere fully inside or outside another field.
message.frieren_arcana.error.full_mana: Barrier Breaker requires your full equipped mana capacity.
message.frieren_arcana.error.target: Stand inside or beneath an examination barrier: the breaker fires straight up into its dome.
message.frieren_arcana.barrage_on: Barrage active. Cast again, let go of right-click with a staff, or press Stop to end.
message.frieren_arcana.error.staff: Flight requires a staff in either hand.
message.frieren_arcana.error.endgame: Heavy Blast requires endgame mana capacity. Check the spell tooltip.
message.frieren_arcana.error.mastery: Master level V Zoltraak or equip the legendary Heavy Blast spell.
message.frieren_arcana.error.book: Equip a spellbook or imbued item containing Zoltraak or the chosen variant.
message.frieren_arcana.error.water: Reamstroha requires nearby water within 5 blocks.
message.frieren_arcana.error.living_targ: Aim at a living target within 24 blocks.
info.frieren_arcana.barrage_drain: Barrage drain: %s mana/second; no regeneration while active
info.frieren_arcana.heavy: Minimum capacity: %s mana; minimum charge: %s seconds
info.frieren_arcana.device_release: Use again to dismiss your examination field for free.
spell.frieren_arcana.zoltraak_barrage.gu: Toggle a rapid stream of about seven focused shots per second, Fern-style. Continuously drains mana and suppresses regeneration until stopped or exhausted. Keep the spell equipped. Damage: 0.55× spell power per shot, about seven shots a second.
spell.frieren_arcana.zoltraak_heavy.guid: A compressed, much thicker Zoltraak with a long minimum charge and an endgame mana requirement. Multi-target. Terrain and barriers stop it. Damage: the configured heavy-beam damage (100 by default) × your spell-power bonus, to everything in the beam.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.zoltraak_hea: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Zoltraak — Heavy Blast
spell.frieren_arcana.nephtear.guide: Lawine's volley of large ice spears; damages, freezes and slows. Five levels increase power and spear count. Damage: 0.6× spell power per spear, 2 + level spears.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.nephtear: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Nephtear — Ice Spears
spell.frieren_arcana.reamstroha.guide: Kanne's water magic: gathers nearby water into a huge sphere and slams it down. Needs existing water nearby (rain counts in canon; here water blocks within 5). Five levels. Damage: 1.4× spell power to everything in the stream.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.reamstroha: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Reamstroha — Water Control
spell.frieren_arcana.balgrant.guide: Richter's earth magic: stone spikes drive up from the ground and launch nearby foes. Physical mass, so it wears down defensive magic fast. Five levels; terrain is left intact. Damage: 1.3× spell power to everything within 3 + level blocks.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.balgrant: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Bargland — Earth Control
spell.frieren_arcana.jilwer.guide: Laufen's folk speed spell: a burst of movement too fast for the eye. Three levels increase speed and duration. Barriers still confine movement.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.jilwer: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Jilwer — Swift Movement
spell.frieren_arcana.sorganeil.guide: Wirbel's binding: paralyses one target while you keep it in sight; losing sight of it, death or logout releases it. Three levels extend the maximum hold. Deals no damage; holds the target for 4 + 2 × level seconds while you keep it in sight.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.sorganeil: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Sorganeil — Sight Binding
spell.frieren_arcana.reelseiden.guide: Übel's cutting magic: a near-invisible slash that cuts what you can imagine cutting, about five blocks. Five levels. Cannot cut barriers or terrain. Damage: 2.4× spell power to everything in the cut (5 blocks).
death.attack.frieren_arcana.reelseiden: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Reelseiden — Cutting Magic
spell.frieren_arcana.flower_field.guide: Flamme's spell to create a field of flowers, passed on to Frieren. Blossoms open across the ground for 15 seconds. Three levels widen the field. No blocks are placed.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.flower_field: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Field of Flowers
spell.frieren_arcana.goddess_healing.gui: Goddess (priest) magic as used by Heiter and Sein: warm scripture light heals you and grants brief regeneration. Three levels. Heals 4 + 4 × level health, plus Regeneration.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.goddess_heal: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Goddess Magic — Healing
spell.frieren_arcana.goddess_cleansing.g: Goddess magic that lifts afflictions: poison and wither; level II also slowness, level III blindness.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.goddess_clea: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Goddess Magic — Cleansing
spell.frieren_arcana.golden_transmutatio: Manga spoiler: Macht's curse that turns things to gold. Here a 10-second golden restraint rather than permanent transmutation. One legendary level. Deals no damage; holds the target, turning to gold, for 10 seconds.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.golden_trans: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Diagoldze — Golden Curse
message.frieren_arcana.error.bound: You cannot cast while magically restrained.
spell.frieren_arcana.vollzanbel.guide: Frieren's hellfire: pillars of fire erupt like molten lava at the target area. Three levels increase damage and radius. Ignites foes; leaves terrain intact. Damage: 2× spell power within 2 + level blocks, and burning for 3 + level seconds.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.vollzanbel: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Vollzanbel — Hellfire Summoning
spell.frieren_arcana.judradjim.guide: Frieren's destructive lightning: purple bolts that run wild around the target area while the caster is unharmed. Three levels increase damage and radius. Damage: 2.2× spell power to everything within 1.5 + level blocks.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.judradjim: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Judradjim — Destructive Lightning
spell.frieren_arcana.waldgose.guide: Denken's tornado magic: a cyclone that damages and lifts foes. Five levels. Leaves a four-second window to turn it into Daosdorg. Damage: 0.8× spell power within 2 + level blocks, and Levitation.
spell.frieren_arcana.daosdorg.guide: Denken's follow-up: within four seconds of your Waldgose, turn its cyclone into a roaring fire tornado. Five levels. Does not set blocks on fire. Damage: 1.8× spell power within 3 + level blocks of the Waldgose, and burning for 3 + level seconds.
spell.frieren_arcana.catastrovia.guide: Denken's rain of exploding arrows of light, falling from a circle above onto your line of fire. Five levels. Terrain and barriers stop it. Damage: 1.8× spell power to everything along the line of fire.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.catastrovia: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Catastravia — Lights of Judgment
spell.frieren_arcana.jubelade.guide: Scharf's spell: flower petals harden into razor steel blades. Requires nearby flower blocks or your flower field. Five levels. Does not consume flowers. Damage: 1.3× spell power to everything in the stream of blades.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.jubelade: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Jubelade — Steel Petals
spell.frieren_arcana.dragate.guide: Ehre's stone magic: rocks lift beside you and are flung like cannon shot. Physical mass, so it wears down defensive magic fast. Five levels; terrain is not harvested. Damage: 0.65× spell power per rock, 2 + level rocks.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.dragate: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Doragate — Stone Bullets
spell.frieren_arcana.object_levitation.g: Channel to grab a creature or dropped item within 12/14/16 blocks and move it with your aim. Uses Iron Telekinesis for creatures. Press Throw (U by default) to throw the target. Costs 25 mana per channel pulse; releases when casting stops.
spell.frieren_arcana.goddess_three_spear: Sein's goddess magic: three tight lances of light. Three levels increase power. Terrain and barriers still apply. Damage: 0.9× spell power per spear, three spears.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.goddess_thre: %1$s was overcome by %2$s’s Goddess Magic — Three Spears
jei.frieren_arcana.inscription: Use Iron's inscription system to install this scroll in a spellbook. This guide describes spell behavior; it is not a crafting recipe.
jei.frieren_arcana.reference: Reference page; no recipe transfer. Hover the scroll for full spell details.
jei.frieren_arcana.staff: Hold this staff, an Iron's staff, or a tagged flight staff in either hand to fly. The other hand remains available. A staff is shown below the flying player. Crafting is shown in JEI's normal crafting category.
jei.frieren_arcana.release: Right-click to release both of your saved barrier types. Dismissal is free. Other players cannot dismiss your barriers with this item.
jei.frieren_arcana.device: Reusable examination dome device. Right-click to create its tier size; use again to release your existing field for free. Shared owner slot with Examination Barrier. The whole sphere must fit world height and borders. No duration or upkeep. Crafting/upgrade recipes are in JEI's crafting category.
message.frieren_arcana.error.flowers: Steel Petals requires nearby flowers or your cosmetic flower field.
message.frieren_arcana.error.wind: Cast your Tornado first, then Fire-Wind within four seconds.
message.frieren_arcana.error.item_target: Aim at a creature or dropped item
spell.frieren_arcana.barrier_breaker.sum: Shatters the examination barrier above you
spell.frieren_arcana.sorganeil.summary: Binds a target while you watch it
spell.frieren_arcana.golden_transmutatio: Gold creeps over and restrains a target
spell.frieren_arcana.vollzanbel.summary: Pillars of hellfire erupt at the target
spell.frieren_arcana.judradjim.summary: Wild purple lightning around the target
spell.frieren_arcana.dragate.summary: Levitated rocks flung like cannon shot
spell.frieren_arcana.object_levitation.s: Grab and move targets; Throw (U) flings them
info.frieren_arcana.preview.repeating: Hits repeatedly while the wind lasts
spell.frieren_arcana.black_hole.guide: The Spiegel copy's spell from ep. 26: a black core in a blazing corona forms at your fingertips, flies slowly along your aim dragging creatures and rubble after it, crushes the rubble into a red-cracked mass, then collapses in a blast. Plays a short cutscene for the caster (K / Esc skips). Three levels widen the pull. Damage: 0.35× spell power every half second to anything inside it, then 1.6× spell power within 5 blocks when it collapses.
spell.frieren_arcana.black_hole.summary: A collapsing black hole that drags foes in
spell.frieren_arcana.height_of_magic.gui: Frieren's telekinetic repulsion (ep. 26): no mana can be sensed and nothing is seen but the air bending. Throws every foe in front of you across the field. One legendary level. Damage: 0.5× spell power to everything thrown.
death.attack.frieren_arcana.height_of_ma: %1$s was thrown by %2$s’s Height of Magic
spell.frieren_arcana.golem_fist.guide: Golem magic like the exam's golem bottles: a huge stone fist bursts from the ground at your target and launches everything above it. Physical mass breaks defensive magic quickly. Three levels. Damage: 1.5× spell power within 2.2 + 0.5 × level blocks, launching targets upward.
spell.frieren_arcana.golem_fist.summary: A stone fist erupts from the ground
